name: Divine Defender
summary: A protective champion who spends healing power to shield nearby allies and binds a celestial spirit into armor.

features.name: Shared Defense +1
features.summary: Spend one use of lay on hands to grant adjacent allies sacred AC, CMD, and saving-throw bonuses for Charisma-modifier rounds.

features.name: Shared Defense (10 feet)
features.summary: Shared Defense reaches 10 feet and automatically stabilizes allies below 0 hit points.
features.scaling: 15 feet and bleed immunity at 12th; 20 feet and 25% critical/sneak negation at 18th

features.name: Armor Bond
features.summary: Call a celestial spirit into worn armor, granting enhancement or defensive armor properties for 1 minute per Paladin level.
features.uses: once per day plus one every 4 levels after 5th
